{{Term/Store|Ancient Proficiency||Series, BotW}} is a [[Set Bonus]] in {{BotW}}.<ref>{{Cite Guide|TotK Piggyback|page= 403}}</ref>

==Overview==
Ancient Proficiency is a [[Set Bonus]] that increases the attack power of [[Ancient Weapon]]s by 80%. This boost stacks multiplicatively with the [[Attack Up]] [[Added Effect|Effect]]. The following armors grant Ancient Proficiency:
* [[Ancient Set]] (★★)
* [[Vah Medoh Divine Helm]] (★★) + [[Ancient Cuirass]] (★★) + [[Ancient Greaves]] (★★)
* [[Vah Naboris Divine Helm]] (★★) + [[Ancient Cuirass]] (★★) + [[Ancient Greaves]] (★★)
* [[Vah Rudania Divine Helm]] (★★) + [[Ancient Cuirass]] (★★) + [[Ancient Greaves]] (★★)
* [[Vah Ruta Divine Helm]] (★★) + [[Ancient Cuirass]] (★★) + [[Ancient Greaves]] (★★)
